# FG-CI-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-pipelines`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-pipelines.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_git_timeout_retries_then_records_an_error_pipeline` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のパイプラインを作れませんでした（定義ファイルを読めませんでした）。しばらくしてからもう一度実行してください。
- en: The CI pipeline could not be created (the definition file could not be read). Run it again later.
- id: Pipeline CI tidak dapat dibuat (berkas definisi tidak dapat dibaca). Jalankan lagi nanti.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C2 (plan 14): forge could not read `.forge-ci.yml` at the commit of a push, a merge request version or a manual run, or not the project's protected branches, so no plan was made. The job `ci.pipeline_create` retries what may pass (git timeout FG-GIT-0002, busy FG-GIT-0003 / 0004, the database, a repository still being provisioned FG-REPO-0003); on its last attempt — or at once for a failure that cannot pass — it records the pipeline with status `error` and this code so the push is never left without an answer. A manual run (`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/pipelines`) answers 503 with this code at once (no row). Not the definition's fault (that is FG-CI-0001).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One warn log line `forge.ci.pipeline_create_failed` with `error_code`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `ref`, `sha`, `source` and `cause_code` (the underlying code, e.g. FG-GIT-0002) plus that error's own context (`operation`, `timeout_ms`). The job runner logged each earlier attempt with the underlying code (`kind=ci.pipeline_create`, `job_id`). Read the row: SELECT id, status, error_code, ref, sha FROM forge.ci_pipelines WHERE project_id = <id> ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5; and the job: SELECT id, state, attempts, last_error_code FROM forge.jobs WHERE kind = 'ci.pipeline_create' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-pipelines: fix the cause named by `cause_code` (its own runbook: git-unavailable / git-process-failed / db-unavailable / repository-provisioning), then start the pipeline again by hand (gstn pipeline run --project <id> --ref <branch>).
